dependency_graph.assessment: The graph resolves webrtcvad-wheels 2.0.14.post1 with only psutil and unittest2 as dependencies, matching setup.py extras 'dev' (test-only); no runtime Python dependencies, build backend is setuptools with vendored C (no external native libs). data.summary: daanzu/py-webrtcvad-wheels already supports riscv64 in source (typedefs.h) and builds cleanly downstream (PR #1109) without patches, but PyPI 2.0.14.post1 ships no riscv64 wheels because build.yml CIBW_ARCHS_LINUX omits riscv64. A one-line CI configuration change following the aarch64/ppc64le QEMU precedent is a bounded patch; no prior riscv64 discussion or objection exists. Sole maintainer, no CONTRIBUTING.
